principal.message: Welcome to the official website of SMK Telkom Sidoarjo. As a leading vocational education institution specializing in technology and informatics, we are dedicated to developing a generation that not only excels in industry competencies, but is also resilient, character-driven, and ready to pioneer the digital era. We hope this portal serves as an informative window for all.

why.card4Desc: Operating under international educational organization management standards.
why.card5Desc: Seamless pathway from vocational high school to Telkom university level.
why.card6Desc: Part of the reputable national educational group under Telkom Indonesia.

profilSekolah.heroDesc: SMK Telkom Sidoarjo is an IT and vocational high school under the Telkom Education Foundation, established in 2018 with Grade A accreditation and ISO 21001:2018 certification. Offering TJAT and SIJA majors with a National Plus Curriculum focused on preparing work-ready students skilled in telecommunications networks and software development.
profilSekolah.visiText: To Nurture Resilient, Ethical, and Digitally Empowered Graduates.
profilSekolah.misi1: Developing a comprehensive student character building system to foster resilient, ethical, and digitally-minded graduates.
profilSekolah.misi2: Delivering high quality education with an industry Link and Match curriculum in Information and Communications Technology.
profilSekolah.misi3: Empowering graduates with knowledge and technical skills ready to Work, Continue studies, or Become entrepreneurs.
profilSekolah.akreditasiDesc: SMK Telkom Sidoarjo is officially accredited Grade A by BAN-S/M with high honors, reflecting our commitment to exemplary vocational education governance.

k3.commitmentTitle: 4 Pillars of OSH Culture in Vocational Education
k3.commitmentSubtitle: Implementing Telkom Group industrial occupational health and safety benchmarks to ensure every student explores and learns within a secure, structured, and healthy environment.
k3.pilar1Desc: Safety protocols and governance aligned directly with Telkom Group criteria and national IT industry partners.
k3.pilar2Desc: Instilling Sort, Set in order, Shine, Standardize, and Sustain across every laboratory workstation before and after practice sessions.
k3.pilar3Desc: A mandatory 5-minute safety briefing at the beginning of each lab session to assess potential hazards and verify PPE compliance.
k3.pilar4Desc: Calibrated lighting, balanced ventilation, and optimized workstation postures in computer labs to prevent physical strain.
k3.sopSubtitle: Every workshop and laboratory features dedicated safety protocols engineered to manage specific vocational risks.
k3.apdSubtitle: Students must wear approved personal protective equipment aligned with the specific operational demands of each laboratory environment.
k3.emergencySubtitle: Comprehensive on-campus safety infrastructure to rapidly manage incidents such as fire hazards, seismic activity, or minor injuries.
k3.assemblyPointDesc: An open evacuation area on the Main Campus Field, safe from falling debris and overhead electrical infrastructure.
k3.aparDesc: All labs feature Dry Chemical and CO2 extinguishers accompanied by rapid 4-step operation guides (Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep).
k3.p3kDesc: First Aid kits are located on every floor and inside lab instructor offices, backed by the School Clinic with on-duty staff.
k3.evacuationDesc: Clear directional exit diagrams installed in all corridors and laboratory entrances with emergency lighting support.
k3.downloadsSubtitle: Access lab safety SOP handbooks, workshop safety posters, and hazard report forms.
k3.faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions About Campus Safety
k3.faqSubtitle: Answers to common questions regarding safety guarantees, student insurance coverage, and protective protocols at Skomda.
